title: Filming: Spin It On, Again And Again And Again, Getting Closer by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings filmed promotional clips for the Back To The Egg songs ‘Spin It On’, ‘Again And Again And Again’, and ‘Getting Closer’ on 12 June 1979.

The shoot was directed by Keith ‘Keef’ McMillan, who shot promos for several other songs from the Back To The Egg album in the same week.

The clips promos for ‘Spin It On’ and ‘Getting Closer’ were shot at the Eagle Parachute Centre at Lympne Airport in Lympne, Kent. A 10-foot Wings logo was painted at the top of an aircraft hanger, and the band mimed to ‘Spin It On’ dressed in leather bomber jackets.

They then shot the clip for ‘Again And Again And Again’ in a rapeseed field, before returning to the hanger to film ‘Getting Closer’.

Also attending the shoot was Melody Maker journalist Mark Williams, who interviewed the band in between filming.
